paths.description: Shift from rigid control to embracing complex emergence across personal, team, and relationship healing processes
paths.reasoning: Clear T1 pattern: order (previous rigid control) + entropy (burnout, multiple simultaneous transitions) → complexity (managing multiple healing processes). Clear T2 pattern: complexity + emergence (team culture building, relationship rediscovery, personal growth) → system (interconnected transformations with their own rhythms and laws). Domain matches Cognitive (Head) - user demonstrates sophisticated understanding of systemic relationships and emergent properties.

paths.description: From forced integration creating tension to allowing independent evolution while maintaining awareness of connections
paths.reasoning: T1 pattern: tension (from forced integration) + integration (allowing independent evolution) → synthesis (new approach to multiple transformations). T2 pattern: synthesis + harmony (resilience emerging from proper pacing) → coherence (unified understanding of transformation processes). Domain matches Cognitive (Head) - user demonstrates logical integration of opposing approaches to change management.
